_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), series KLMNM SET-2, Q.P. Code 31/5/2. 32 pages (idx 0-31): idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-30, Hindi on every odd index 3-29 (each the Hindi of the page after it); odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet and idx 13 at full size: no English on any odd page, and every English page ends on a complete question. idx 31 is blank apart from the footer. Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Sections by DISCIPLINE as instruction (ii) prints: A Biology Q1-16 (30 marks), B Chemistry Q17-29 (25), C Physics Q30-39 (25); every printed mark matches sci80_2026. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 2-9, every page footed 31/5/2) for a bare OR and confirming each on the paper: Q10 (A/B), Q15 (c) OR (c), Q16 (A/B), Q27 (A/B), Q28 (c) OR (c), Q29 (A/B), Q34 (A/B), Q38 (c) OR (c), Q39 (A/B) = 9 alternatives. Q13, Q14, Q33, Q35 and Q37 print parts (a)/(b) with no OR and stay one row each. MCQ keys are CBSE's own, read off the scheme as images (20 keyed MCQs: Q1-9, Q17-24, Q30-32; Q8, Q9, Q24 and Q32 are assertion-reason); no void, grace or dual key anywhere in the scheme (Q26's 'Award full marks if balanced chemical equation is written' is conditional). Case-study sub-part marks are printed on this paper (Q15 1/1/2) and match the scheme (Q15, Q28, Q38 all 1 + 1 + 2). Decimal points in Q33's table are ordinary full stops (1.50, 1.46). Sibling of 31/5/1: 41 rows matched it by content on this paper's own pages and reuse its stem, context, options, answer, chapter, subtopic and difficulty byte for byte; 13 rows are new (Q2, Q7, Q9, Q12, Q14, Q19, Q23, Q25, Q26, Q33, Q36, Q39 A and B). Typesetting-only differences ignored when copying: Q18 and Q21 print Al and Cl with an italic l (Al2O3, NaCl, HCl), as 31/5/1 is stored with plain l. Q16's alternatives are swapped relative to 31/5/1 (sugarcane is (A) here).
